{
  "name": "leakstop",
  "displayName": "LeakStop",
  "version": "1.1.0",
  "description": "Stops secrets from leaking before they are written, printed or committed to git.",
  "author": {
    "name": "AlexandreMartinezOlmos",
    "url": "https://github.com/AlexandreMartinezOlmos"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/AlexandreMartinezOlmos/claude-code-leakstop",
  "repository": "https://github.com/AlexandreMartinezOlmos/claude-code-leakstop",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/AlexandreMartinezOlmos/claude-code-leakstop#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/AlexandreMartinezOlmos/claude-code-leakstop/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/AlexandreMartinezOlmos/claude-code-leakstop/blob/main/PRIVACY.md",
  "keywords": [
    "security",
    "secrets",
    "leak-prevention",
    "api-keys",
    "git",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Protection mode",
      "description": "monitor only warns and logs; standard holds critical findings; strict also holds medium findings and blocks reads of sensitive files.",
      "default": "standard"
    },
    "statusLine": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Status line",
      "description": "Show a line under the prompt while LeakStop is on (or paused). When the line is missing, nothing is protecting the session.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
